name: rhdh-plugin-wiring
description: Generates the Red Hat Developer Hub dynamic-plugins.yaml configuration that makes an exported Backstage frontend plugin appear in RHDH: derive the Scalprum name from plugin-manifest.json or the package name, and write the pluginConfig.dynamicPlugins.frontend block with dynamicRoutes, menuItems, mountPoints, appIcons, apiFactories, routeBindings, entity tabs, cards, context menu items, and provider components. Use for "generate the wiring for this plugin", "which mount point does this card need", entity page customization, importName, or a plugin that installs but never renders. To apply the configuration to a running instance instead, use /rhdh-local.
